integrity: Analytic cotree and Dirichlet-cone-measure proof; exact-rational finite checker is corroborating evidence only. No independent assessment has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple cographs and uniform intrinsic/full-dimensional Lebesgue measure in canonical stable-set indicator coordinates only. The converse requires every nonempty induced subgraph. Uniform random stable sets, arbitrary graphs and affine changes of coordinates are not covered. Historical priority of the combined result remains provisional.
title: Cotree moment laws and hereditary covariance-sign characterization of cographs
